items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Pha Terrell, Mary Lou Williams. I knew, I jammed with her.

ctx.x: Andy Kirk was with Mary Lou Williams, "Until The Real Thing Comes Along". They was beautiful. They was there before I got there. But, I didn't play besides Andy as much as I did with some of the rest of them. But, we all knew each other. You know? We was around. But,

I liked him, and I liked his style. He had some beautiful fellows. Pha Terrell, Mary Lou Williams. I knew, I jammed with her. You know, sat down and had some talks with her, you know, during her jazz time.
And, I'd see Andy off and on every time I'd go by the union. And, I'd get him on the phone and say Andy. Do you know where I can find so and so? You know?
